description: This PHP source file defines the CodeArtifactClient class in the Aws\CodeArtifact namespace, which extends the AwsClient class to provide an SDK client for interacting with the AWS CodeArtifact service. The class includes method annotations indicating available API operations, both synchronous and asynchronous.
